title: rubus scaber var. meyeri
intro: Rubus scaber var. meyeri, commonly known as Japanese bramble or Meyer's bramble, is a deciduous shrub belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, sore throats, and rheumatism, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Rubus scaber var. meyeri include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthraquinones, which are responsible for its bioactive properties.
